'''Surracca''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Surracca was mated to [[Delinna]] and lived in the village [[Kiirloor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. When Kiirloor began to suffer a series of problems that culminated in the disappearance of a [[Chywarra|child]], Surracca traveled with Delinna to [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]]'s [[naming day]] ceremony, to ask her for help. The two Wookiees then traveled back to the village with the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. However, while they traveled, there was a groundquake and they arrived at the village to find it very damaged.
